structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. I came away with a short list to look into: my קרן השתלמות, a חשבון ניירות ערך for the S&P 500, and a קרן כספית for money I might need soon, plus maybe קופת גמל להשקעה. The page names the types but gives no numbers, no fees and no clear first step.

stuck.why: I thought it was a pension thing for older people, but the card says you can withdraw at any time. I wasn't sure I read it right.
I expected a first step for my 30k. It points to קרן השתלמות and קרן חדשה מקיפה, which are things I already have through work.
They all look alike. I couldn't tell which one matters for me, so I would rather do nothing.

findings.what: No numbers at all, no fees or returns, so I can't tell what's worth it
מאיפה להתחיל doesn't cover someone with cash who wants to invest
About 30 identical-looking cards. Too many options that look the same
findings.where: איפה הכסף מוחזק and במה הכסף מושקע

findings.what: Every index card repeats 'הכסף מושקע בשקלים דרך קרן שעוקבת אחריו, עם חשיפה לדולר או מנוטרלת ממנו', so I had to reread it each time to find what's different
